```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load required packages
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(stringr)
```

## Data Loading and Processing

```{r load}
# READY TO TEST

data_dir <- "../userstudy_logs"

tlx_survey_dir <- "C:/Users/Ryan/PycharmProjects/maisr/userstudy_logs"

preference_dir <- "C:/Users/Ryan/PycharmProjects/maisr/userstudy_logs"



# Find all JSON files under session_data folders
json_files <- list.files(
  path = data_dir,
  pattern = "\\.json$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
) %>%
  str_subset("session_data/") # Only keep files under 'session_data'

# Read all files into one dataframe
all_data <- map_dfr(json_files, function(file) {
  json <- fromJSON(file)
  as_tibble(json$episodes)
})
head(all_data)


summary_data <- all_data %>%
  group_by(subject_id) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_episode_timesteps = mean(total_timesteps, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_final_targets = mean(final_targets_identified, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_final_threats = mean(final_threats_identified, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
#summary_data


agent_summary <- all_data %>%
  filter(agent_type %in% c("A", "B", "C")) %>%
  group_by(subject_id, agent_type) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_timesteps = mean(total_timesteps, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_targets = mean(final_targets_identified, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_threats = mean(final_threats_identified, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = agent_type,
    values_from = c(avg_timesteps, avg_targets, avg_threats),
    names_glue = "agent{agent_type}_{.value}"
  )
#agent_summary


final_dataset <- summary_data %>%
  left_join(agent_summary, by = "subject_id")
final_dataset

```

## Performance Comparison
### Overall (Average of rounds)
```{r viz}
# READY TO TEST

# Reshape the dataset to a long format for ggplot
plot_data <- final_dataset %>%
  select(subject_id,
         agentA_avg_timesteps, agentA_avg_targets, agentA_avg_threats,
         agentB_avg_timesteps, agentB_avg_targets, agentB_avg_threats,
         agentC_avg_timesteps, agentC_avg_targets, agentC_avg_threats) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -subject_id,
    names_to = c("agent", "metric"),
    names_pattern = "agent([ABC])_avg_(.*)"
  )

# Make the metric names more descriptive for plotting
plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    metric = case_when(
      metric == "timesteps" ~ "Mission Duration (Steps)",
      metric == "targets" ~ "Targets Identified",
      metric == "threats" ~ "Threats Identified"
    ),
    agent = paste("Agent", agent)
  )

# Plot all three metrics with facets
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = agent, y = value, fill = agent)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Performance Metrics by Agent Type",
    x = "Agent",
    y = "Average Value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```


### Per-round
### Per-round
```{r agent_level_performance}

# Create dataset with agent and level breakdown
agent_level_data <- all_data %>%
  filter(agent_type %in% c("A", "B", "C")) %>%
  mutate(
    agent_letter = agent_type,
    level_num = level
  ) %>%
  group_by(subject_id, agent_letter, level_num) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_timesteps = mean(total_timesteps, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_targets = mean(final_targets_identified, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_threats = mean(final_threats_identified, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculate summary statistics for error bars
agent_level_summary <- agent_level_data %>%
  group_by(agent_letter, level_num) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_timesteps = mean(avg_timesteps, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_timesteps = sd(avg_timesteps, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    mean_targets = mean(avg_targets, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_targets = sd(avg_targets, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    mean_threats = mean(avg_threats, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_threats = sd(avg_threats, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Reshape for plotting (combine mean and SE correctly)
plot_summary <- agent_level_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_timesteps, mean_targets, mean_threats),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "mean_value",
    names_prefix = "mean_"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    agent_level_summary %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c(se_timesteps, se_targets, se_threats),
        names_to = "metric",
        values_to = "se_value",
        names_prefix = "se_"
      ),
    by = c("agent_letter", "level_num", "metric")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metric = case_when(
      metric == "timesteps" ~ "Mission Duration (steps)",
      metric == "targets" ~ "Targets Identified",
      metric == "threats" ~ "Threats Identified"
    ),
    agent_label = paste("Agent", agent_letter),
    level_label = paste("Level", level_num)
  )

# Create bar charts for each level
levels_to_plot <- c(1, 3, 4, 5, 7)

for (level in levels_to_plot) {
  level_data <- plot_summary %>% filter(level_num == level)
  
  p <- ggplot(level_data, aes(x = agent_label, y = mean_value, fill = agent_label)) +
    geom_col(alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = mean_value - se_value, ymax = mean_value + se_value),
      width = 0.2, color = "black"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Performance Metrics by Agent - Level", level),
      x = "Agent",
      y = "Mean Value",
      caption = "Error bars represent standard error"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
    ) +
    scale_fill_brewer(type = "qual", palette = "Set2")
  
  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")
}

# Optional: Combined plot
combined_plot <- ggplot(plot_summary %>% filter(level_num %in% levels_to_plot), 
                       aes(x = agent_label, y = mean_value, fill = agent_label)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_value - se_value, ymax = mean_value + se_value),
    width = 0.2, color = "black"
  ) +
  facet_grid(level_num ~ metric, scales = "free_y", 
             labeller = labeller(level_num = function(x) paste("Level", x))) +
  labs(
    title = "Performance Metrics by Agent and Level",
    x = "Agent",
    y = "Mean Value",
    caption = "Error bars represent standard error"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold")
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(type = "qual", palette = "Set2")

print(combined_plot)

```
## Workload Surveys
### Load
```{r tlx_load}
# Load all survey files matching the pattern
survey_files <- list.files(
  tlx_survey_dir,
  pattern = "^tlx_survey_responses_subject_.*\\.json$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Read and combine all survey responses
survey_data <- map_dfr(survey_files, function(file) {
  # Extract subject_id from filename
  subject_id <- str_extract(basename(file), "\\d+")
  
  # Read JSON as tibble and add subject_id
  fromJSON(file) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(subject_id = as.integer(subject_id))
})

# Pivot to wide format: one row per subject, 5 columns per episode config
tlx_wide <- survey_data %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = subject_id,
    names_from = config,
    values_from = c(mental_demand, temporal_demand, effort, performance, frustration),
    names_glue = "{episode_config}_{.value}"
  )

```
### Plot
```{r tlx_plots}
# Compute composite TLX per episode
tlx_long <- survey_data %>%
  mutate(
    agent_letter = str_sub(config, 1, 1),
    level_num = as.integer(str_sub(config, 2, 2)),
    composite_tlx = (mental_demand + temporal_demand + effort + performance + frustration) / 5
  )

### 8.1 Composite TLX vs Agent Letter
ggplot(tlx_long, aes(x = agent_letter, y = composite_tlx, fill = agent_letter)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(
    title = "Composite TLX vs Agent Letter",
    x = "Agent Letter",
    y = "Composite TLX Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

### 8.2 Effort and Frustration vs Agent Letter
tlx_long %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(effort, frustration), names_to = "metric", values_to = "score") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = agent_letter, y = score, fill = agent_letter)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Effort and Frustration vs Agent Letter",
    x = "Agent Letter",
    y = "Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

### 8.3 Composite TLX vs Level Number
ggplot(tlx_long, aes(x = factor(level_num), y = composite_tlx, fill = factor(level_num))) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(
    title = "Composite TLX vs Level Number",
    x = "Level Number",
    y = "Composite TLX Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

## Preference Surveys
### Heatmap
``` {r preference-load}

# Load all teammate survey JSON files
teammate_files <- list.files(
  preference_dir,
  pattern = "^teammate_survey_subject_.*\\.json$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Map colors to agent letters
color_to_agent <- c(
  "red" = "A",
  "purple" = "B",
  "green" = "C"
)

# Combine all survey responses into a single dataframe
teammate_data <- map_dfr(teammate_files, function(file) {
  subject_id <- str_extract(basename(file), "\\d+")
  json <- fromJSON(file)
  as_tibble(json) %>%
    mutate(subject_id = as.integer(subject_id))
}) %>%
  # Map colors to agents
  mutate(
    compared_agents = map(compared_agents, ~ color_to_agent[.x]),
    agent1 = map_chr(compared_agents, 1),
    agent2 = map_chr(compared_agents, 2),
    preferred_overall = color_to_agent[preferred_overall]
  ) %>%
  select(subject_id, config, agent1, agent2, preferred_overall)

# ---- Create confusion-matrix style table ----
# Initialize all combinations of agents
agent_levels <- c("A", "B", "C")
pairs <- expand.grid(agent1 = agent_levels, agent2 = agent_levels, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Compute preference scores: +1 if first agent preferred, -1 if second preferred
pref_scores <- teammate_data %>%
  mutate(score = ifelse(preferred_overall == agent1, 1,
                        ifelse(preferred_overall == agent2, -1, 0))) %>%
  group_by(agent1, agent2) %>%
  summarise(mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Merge with all pairs to ensure full matrix
pref_matrix <- pairs %>%
  left_join(pref_scores, by = c("agent1", "agent2")) %>%
  replace_na(list(mean_score = 0))

# Heatmap using ggplot
ggplot(pref_matrix, aes(x = agent2, y = agent1, fill = mean_score)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(mean_score, 2)), color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "brown", mid = "white", high = "blue", midpoint = 0) +
  labs(
    title = "Teammate Preference Confusion Matrix",
    x = "Agent (Column)",
    y = "Agent (Row)",
    fill = "Preference"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  coord_fixed()

```

## Statistical Tests
### Performance
```{r stat}
metrics <- unique(plot_data$metric)

for (m in metrics) {
  cat("\n### Metric:", m, "\n")
  
  # Subset data for this metric
  df_metric <- plot_data %>% filter(metric == m)
  
  # One-way ANOVA
  aov_res <- aov(value ~ agent, data = df_metric)
  cat("\n--- ANOVA ---\n")
  print(summary(aov_res))
  
  # Kruskal-Wallis Test (non-parametric)
  cat("\n--- Kruskal-Wallis Test ---\n")
  print(kruskal.test(value ~ agent, data = df_metric))
  
  # Pairwise t-tests with Holm correction
  cat("\n--- Pairwise t-tests (Holm corrected) ---\n")
  print(pairwise.t.test(df_metric$value, df_metric$agent, p.adjust.method = "holm"))
}


```
